source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of wave-particle duality (PDF 127-128).

blocks.text: Roshni ka interference aur diffraction us ki lehar wali fitrat ka saboot hain, jab ke photoelectric effect aur Compton effect us ki zarrati fitrat sabit karte hain. Isi tarah Davisson aur Germer aur G. P. Thomson ke tajurbat electrons ki lehar jaisi fitrat dikhate hain, jab ke e/m maloom karne ke J. J. Thomson ke tajurbe mein electron ki zarre jaisi fitrat farz karni pari. Isi tarah hamein tamam maddah (electrons, protons, neutrons, molecules) aur roshni, X-rays aur gamma rays ke liye lehar aur zarre dono jaisi khasiyatein farz karni parti hain. Maddah aur shuaon ki dohri 'lehar-zarra' fitrat hai; ise wave-particle duality kehte hain.

Niels Bohr ka complementarity ka usool kehta hai ke shuaon aur maddah ki mukammal wazahat ke liye lehar aur zarra dono pehlu zaruri hain. Dono hamesha maujood hain aur koi bhi tajurbe se zahir ho sakta hai, lekin aik tajurbe mein dono aik saath nahi. Kaun sa pehlu nazar aaye yeh tajurbe par munhasir hai: roshni ki shua ke raaste mein diffraction grating use lehar dikhati, jab ke dhaat ki satah se takrati roshni ko zarrat ki dhaar samjhna parta hai. Roshni maddah se amal karte waqt photons ki dhaar aur source se pakre jane ki jagah tak safar karte waqt lehar ki tarah bartao karti hai. Darasal tamam khurd zarrat aise phailte hain jaise lehrein hon aur aise tawanai badalte hain jaise zarrat hon.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Agar electrons sirf zarrat ki tarah bartao karte aur un mein lehar ki khasiyatein na hotin to double slit par bheji shua aik ya doosri slit se guzar kar screen par slits ki do roshan tasaveer banati. Haqeeqat mein screen roshni ki tarah roshan aur andhere fringes ka naqsha dikhati hai: dono slits ki electron lehrein interference karti hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Electrons ki shua double slit ki taraf; peeche screen par sirf double slit ki do roshan tasaveer. (b) Wahi shua aur double slit; screen par roshan aur andhere fringes ka naqsha.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain?: electrons ki shua aur double slit, (a) agar electrons sirf zarrat hote, (b) haqeeqat mein (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: (a) Roshni aur (b) electrons ki lehar wali fitrat dikhane wala aik aur zarrati fitrat dikhane wala aik tajurba batayein.
blocks.explanation: (a) Roshni: interference ya diffraction (lehar); photoelectric ya Compton effect (zarra). (b) Electrons: Davisson-Germer ya G. P. Thomson diffraction (lehar); J. J. Thomson ka e/m tajurba (zarra).

items: Maddah aur shuaein lehar aur zarra dono fitratein dikhate.
Complementarity (Bohr): dono zaruri, lekin aik tajurba sirf aik dikhata.
